name: unitrack-monorepo
description: Cross-platform academic planner for school and university students

scripts.render:build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @unitrack/contracts build && pnpm --filter @unitrack/i18n build && pnpm --filter @unitrack/academic-core build && pnpm --filter @unitrack/api-client build && pnpm --filter @unitrack/api build
scripts.render:start: pnpm --filter @unitrack/api exec prisma migrate deploy && node apps/api/dist/index.js
